title: Powering Tomorrow: The Future of Energy
shared_passage: Watch a video about the future of fuel and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: Saudi Arabia...
options: is the biggest producer of oil and gas.

questions.question: The United States...
options: doesn't have to import oil from OPEC countries.
only imports oil from Saudi Arabia, Venezuela and Iraq.
is less dependent on imported oil now.

questions.question: Oil...
options: is the source of most of the world's energy.
is the world's most used fuel.
will cost less and less every year.

questions.question: According to the video, by 2040...
options: we will produce less traditional energy.
the energy will be much cleaner.

questions.question: China is...
options: the world leader in electric car sales.
the country that consumes most oil.
the biggest manufacturer of solar panels.

questions.question: The transition to clean energy...
options: will produce wars in the Middle East.
will require the collaboration of the different countries.
